from typing import Iterable, TypeVar, Generic, List, Optional

from rich.console import RenderableType, Group
from rich.measure import Measurement
from rich.text import Text

T = TypeVar('T', bound=RenderableType)

class GroupFactory(Generic[T]):
    """A factory class to create a consolidated renderable group from multiple items."""

    @staticmethod
    def create_render_group(*items: T, fit: bool = True) -> Group:
        """Create a consolidated renderable group from multiple items.

        Args:
            *items (T): The items to include in the render group.
            fit (bool, optional): Whether to fit the dimensions of the group to the contents or fill available space. Defaults to True.

        Returns:
            Group: A renderable group containing all the provided items.
        """
        return Group(*items, fit=fit)
